description: This file defines a React component named Toolbar, providing a control bar with actions such as adding columns, exporting and importing CSV files, managing bulk uploads, and toggling fullscreen mode in a Kanban board application.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate()
methods.description: Generates and prompts download of an Excel template with predefined columns for Kanban cards.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Opens the modal to add a new column.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submitting the new column addition, adding the column to the Kanban board.

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Reads and processes an uploaded Excel file to prepare for bulk card insertion.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Confirms the bulk upload, processes the entries, and inserts cards into a specific column.

methods.name: handleExportCardsCsv
methods.description: Exports current cards to a CSV file and initiates download.

methods.name: handleCsvFileSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a CSV file for re-import/ synchronization.

methods.name: handleConfirmCsvSync
methods.description: Performs CSV synchronization, updating or inserting cards based on CSV data.

methods.name: handleUndoCsvSync
methods.description: Undoes the last CSV sync operation, restoring previous state.

methods.name: Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })

ctags.name: Toolbar
ctags.pattern: /^function Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
